headline: Weekend CME halt spans the full window after a hawkish Jackson Hole Friday: NDX closed 29,433.43 (-0.70%), NQ last 29,491.75, VIX 14.43
body: CME Globex has been halted since Friday 21:00 UTC and does not reopen until Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC, so every hour of this forecast window is a closed venue with no Nasdaq-100 price discovery. Verified pre-halt evidence: cash NDX closed 29,433.43, down 0.70 percent, inside a 29,383.92 to 29,752.78 range against a 29,641.56 previous close; NQ futures last printed 29,491.75, down 0.69 percent, in a 29,436.75 to 29,811.50 range; VIX finished at 14.43 within a 14.13 to 14.84 range. Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote was read as hawkish on inflation, and reporting places September rate-hike odds near 57 to 59 percent against about 35 percent the prior day, with the 2-year yield reported near 4.35 percent and the 10-year near 4.72 percent; official H.15 readings for 27 August are 2Y 4.20 percent and 10Y 4.67 percent. Friday's internals were dispersed rather than aligned: the Dow finished essentially flat at -0.02 percent and the S&P 500 at -0.25 percent while the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.52 percent, as hyperscalers advanced, with Amazon about 4 percent higher and Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta between 1.2 and 1.7 percent higher, while chipmakers retreated, Nvidia about 4.6 percent lower and the semiconductor group down roughly 3 percent. WTI sits near 83.44 dollars and Brent near 88.29 dollars after a weekly decline of about 4 percent. That rotation profile is a Stress and Confidence input rather than evidence of the persistent one-way index path Tail measures, and no such path can form while the venue is closed. Tail is therefore held at 5 across the window, the dominant mode is normal in every slot, and no danger window is defined. The next evidence checkpoint is the Globex reopen on Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC, beyond this window, followed by the 1 to 4 September catalyst stack of ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS, ADP, jobless claims and trade balance, ISM Services and August payrolls.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours cover Friday's full session and the opening hours of the weekend halt. Tail ran 11 to 13 with Stress in the high 40s to mid 50s through the Asian and European hours as positioning built ahead of the Jackson Hole keynote. Tail peaked at 22 and Stress at 64 in the 16:00 to 19:00 UTC block, when the hawkish keynote produced event-driven two-way trade and the mode was scored event/whipsaw; the mapped policy state never exceeded WATCH because retracements kept occurring. After the 20:00 UTC cash close the readings decayed quickly, Tail from 12 to 5 and Stress from 52 to 22, as the venue entered the weekend closure and the mode reverted to normal. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 28 August, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: Every hour of the forecast window falls inside the CME weekend halt, so no Nasdaq-100 price path can form and Tail is held at 5 in all 24 slots, keeping the mapped policy state at EA_ON throughout with no danger window. Stress runs 23 to 28, crossing from the low into the moderate band around Saturday midday, carrying the unresolved September policy repricing and the 1 to 4 September catalyst stack of ISM Manufacturing and JOLTS, ADP, jobless claims and trade balance, ISM Services and August payrolls. Confidence eases from 81 to 75 purely as Friday's verified prints age; the evidence base of levels, yields, volatility, oil and calendar is complete but cannot be refreshed until the venue reopens. The dominant mode is normal in every slot because a closed market has no structure to classify. Weekend headline and gap exposure accumulates across the window, but the Globex reopen on Sunday 30 August at 22:00 UTC lies beyond the final slot, so reopening structure is explicitly not forecast here.
